hotels.title: Stylish Vancouver Boutique Stay at Hotel Belmont MGallery Collection
hotels.description: Set in Vancouver’s West End, this refined MGallery address places English Bay, Stanley Park and the Seawall within easy reach. Robson Street’s boutiques and galleries are close by, while Coal Harbour’s waterfront dining and seaplane terminal sit a short drive away. Inside, the hotel pairs contemporary design with a polished, intimate feel. Guests can dine at the onsite restaurant, sip crafted drinks in the bar, and return to rooms fitted with plush bedding and marble bathrooms
